scenes.text: Why isn't this a Spring bean?
scenes.phonemes: wˌaɪ ˌɪzənt ðɪs ɐ spɹˈɪŋ bˈiːn?

scenes.text: A class on the classpath isn't automatically registered. Give Spring a registration path.
scenes.phonemes: ɐ klˈæs ɔnðə klˈæspæθ ˌɪzənt ˌɔːɾəmˈæɾɪkli ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚd. ɡˈɪv spɹˈɪŋ ɐ ɹˌɛdʒɪstɹˈeɪʃən pˈæθ.

scenes.text: Register configuration with a bean method. Spring calls the factory and manages its result.
scenes.phonemes: ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚ kənfˌɪɡjɚɹˈeɪʃən wɪð ɐ bˈiːn mˈɛθəd. spɹˈɪŋ kˈɔːlz ðə fˈæktɚɹi ænd mˈænɪdʒᵻz ɪts ɹɪzˈʌlt.

scenes.text: Or add the component annotation, then scan the package containing your class.
scenes.phonemes: ɔːɹ ˈæd ðə kəmpˈoʊnənt ˌænətˈeɪʃən, ðˈɛn skˈæn ðə pˈækɪdʒ kəntˈeɪnɪŋ jʊɹ klˈæs.

scenes.text: Miss that package, and even an annotated class stays unregistered.
scenes.phonemes: mˈɪs ðæt pˈækɪdʒ, ænd ˈiːvən ɐn ˈænətˌeɪɾᵻd klˈæs stˈeɪz ˌʌnɹˈɛdʒɪstɚd.

scenes.text: Our tests retrieve both. Two paths, one result: Spring knows which beans to manage.
scenes.phonemes: ˌaʊɚ tˈɛsts ɹᵻtɹˈiːv bˈoʊθ. tˈuː pˈæθs, wˈʌn ɹɪzˈʌlt: spɹˈɪŋ nˈoʊz wˌɪtʃ bˈiːnz tə mˈænɪdʒ.
